Adversarial attempts: broken-but-passing (probe accepts any HTTP status incl. 500 or 404 on /) is not a row-23 issue because the gates require sign-in and server-backed readback; conforming-but-failing candidates (binding 'localhost'/::1, static path from process.cwd(), reading /assets at runtime, requiring an extra env var like SESSION_SECRET, seeding before listen, installing packages) are each explicitly warned against in the brief/notes. Residual notes (not defects): (a) a self-tested app.db left in /app would be used as-is because DB_PATH=/app/app.db; the brief says 'start with no shipped database', so this is told. (b) The restart helper sends SIGTERM to the process group and relaunches after 5 s; an app with a graceful SIGTERM handler that waits on open SSE streams would hit EADDRINUSE and lose hro_intake_restart (4.5/61 legs). The brief only says 'keep new work across restarts'; exiting on SIGTERM is Node's default and a professional norm, so P3 latent at most.
